summary: The candidate narrowly prevents DeepSeek-V4's unsupported CPU-copy NotImplementedError from terminating the scheduler by converting it into the existing backup-failure signal. However, with disaggregation_decode_enable_offload_kvcache=false it still attempts CPU offload and consequently aborts the affected request after freeing its device KV. This is partial crash containment, not a full fix of the original disabled-offload retraction contract.

tests.what_was_measured: On recorded base, DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool.get_cpu_copy is KVCache.get_cpu_copy and cpu_tensor retraction backup propagates NotImplementedError.
At the exact candidate commit, all four candidate regression cases passed: method ownership, unsupported-copy containment, supported-copy success, and unrelated-error propagation.
With decode mode and disaggregation_decode_enable_offload_kvcache=false, release_req still attempted offload once, returned false, released device KV, and reset the request.
Two existing GPU tests passed, covering host-pool exhaustion and exact MHA target/draft KV backup and restore on the assigned AMD GPU.
Candidate patch whitespace and changed Python syntax.

gpu_execution.evidence: The existing decode retraction backup suite performed exact torch.equal checks after GPU KV overwrite/restore on one AMD Instinct MI355X reporting capability (9, 5), ROCm 7.2. This validates supported MHA host-pool mechanics, not DSV4 or distributed execution.

remaining_counterexamples: When disaggregation_decode_enable_offload_kvcache is false and the resolved retraction backend is cpu_tensor, release_req still invokes req.offload_kv_cache.
For DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool that invocation remains unsupported; the candidate aborts the retracted request instead of preserving it for resume/recompute.
The original tp8/dp8 DeepSeek-V4 speculative HiSparse workload was not run, so full serving behavior and race timing remain unverified.
remaining_limitations: No DeepSeek-V4 weights or tp8/dp8 multi-node PD environment were available.
Only one assigned gfx950-class AMD Instinct MI355X was available; no H20/CUDA comparison was performed.
The candidate changes Python only, so no native source changed and no native rebuild was applicable.
The GPU suite exercises MHA host-pool backup/restore, not DeepSeekV4TokenToKVPool, HiSparse kernels, MTP4 speculation, semantic accuracy, or sustained KV-full load.
